title: Decoder floors, case (c): the B-locus of the A2 family (completes #2784's m ≥ 10 claim: P112 ≥ 64, #968 P104 ≥ 56, E8 ≥ 72; no κ claim)
body:
**Status: research note with exact finite computations and a written proof (not a SAT/DRAT proof). No κ claim, no supplier word.** Only `research/a2-family-b-locus/` is added; nothing existing is changed.

## Results

#2784 left open its Claim M (`m ≥ 10`, decoders `M = P Qᵀ` with factors in the realisation's two 9-dimensional spaces, dense `B`, iff pattern, characteristic 0) on the B-locus `γ₂ = γ₃` of the A2 family. This closes it.

* **PROVEN (§1):** B-locus members are of B-form, `M = D₁G + 1_X βᵀ`, `supp β ⊆ X`: a rank-one change of the 3×3 triangle block only.
* **PROVEN from CHECKED facts (a)–(e) (§2):** on the B-locus every such decoder with `m ≥ 10` costs **≥ 64 (P112), ≥ 72 (E8)**; for P104 (all 28 triangle representatives) **≥ 58 when the decoder still has ≥ 10 terms after merging parallel terms**, otherwise Theorem F's 56 (so the combined P104 bound stays 56). The key checked input is `Q_XX` = 62 / 56 / 70, the square lower bound with the triangle deleted on both sides (opt3u duality branch-and-bound, complete); the rest is a per-term bound c′ ≥ 7, a class-level inside relaxation (66 / 63 / 75 at 9 terms) and a rank fact on the three triangle normals. The transposed family follows by symmetry.
* **With #2784 (off the locus 68 / 64 / 77; Theorem F at `m = 9`): Claim M holds on the whole A2 family**: P112 ≥ 64, #968 P104 ≥ 56, E8 ≥ 72, every `m ≥ 9`, factors in the spaces.
* The relaxation values 62 / 70 (P112 / E8) that made the locus look open are not decoders: the optimum needs three cost-7 terms with row normals ∝ r₁, r₂, r₃ inside an 8-term inside decoder, impossible since they span 2 dimensions. For P104 the value 58 equals the relaxation value.

## Scope and caveats

* Floors for decoders whose realisation `N` is a member of the A2 family and whose factors lie in that realisation's spaces; nothing is claimed for other rank-9 realisations, non-iff patterns or `B` of rank ≥ 10.
* **Out-of-space `m ≥ 10`** (#2784 §7.3) stays **open**.
* **Tightness of 64 / 72 on the B-locus is not claimed and was not checked** (the tie decoders of #2784 are off the locus).
* No κ claim.

## Verification

`bash research/a2-family-b-locus/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (Python ≥ 3.11, `numpy`, `networkx`). On a fresh `git archive` export: **50 PASS, 0 FAIL**, 172 s wall (`nice 10`; the 28 P104 representatives and the `Q_XX` partial punctures run 6 at a time, each under `timeout 1200`). It re-runs facts (a)–(e) including `Q_XX` on P112, E8 and all 28 P104 representatives (outputs compared byte-for-byte with the recorded logs), the relaxation with the `e₉` row and column, and the inside relaxation. The needed files of #2784 (`a2lib`, `opt3u` and their imports) are vendored unchanged so the package is self-contained (`NOTICE.md`, `SOURCES.json`, `MANIFEST.sha256`).

## Overlap

Follow-up to #2784 (ours); parents #2338, #2724, #2277 (ours). Cited: #968. No other overlap expected.
